==English==

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:inh|enm:avengen<ety:bor<fro:avengier>>|tree=1|text=++}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/əˈvɛnd͡ʒ/}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-avenge.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɛndʒ|s=2}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To take [[vengeance]] (for); to exact [[satisfaction]] for by punishing the injuring party; to [[vindicate]] by inflicting pain or evil on a [[wrongdoer]].
#: {{co|en|to '''avenge''' the murder of his brother}}
#: {{ux|en|They '''avenged'''  the  wrong  done  to  them.}}
#* {{RQ:Milton Poems 1673|sonnet=XV|page=58|passage='''Avenge''' O Lord thy ſlaughter'd Saints, whoſe bones / Lie ſcatter'd on the Alpine mountains cold,}}
#* {{quote-av|en
|year=1984
|role=w:Paul Atreides
|title={{w|Dune (1984 film)|Dune}}
|url=https://archive.org/details/Dune19843640x272435mb
|genre=[[science fiction|Science Fiction]]
|oclc=1295459964
|time=2:01:42
|text=Father, today I will '''avenge''' your death.}}
# {{lb|en|reflexive}} To [[revenge]] oneself (''on'' or ''upon'' someone).
# {{lb|en|intransitive|obsolete}} To take [[vengeance]].
#* {{RQ:King James Version|Leviticus|19|18|passage=Thou shalt not '''auenge''' nor beare any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt loue thy neighbor as thy selfe: I am the Lord.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive|archaic}} To treat [[revengefully]]; to [[wreak]] [[vengeance]] on.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1609|author=Bishop Hall|title=Some few of David's Psalmes Metaphrased
|passage=thy judgment in '''avenging''' thine enemies}}

====Usage notes====
The object of "avenge" is generally the act of injury or the injured party, never (in modern usage) the injuring party. The injuring party may be specified with "on," as in "to avenge X on his killer," but this is rather more common with "take/get revenge" and "[[revenge]] oneself" than with "avenge."

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|take vengeance}} {{l|en|bewreak}}, {{l|en|get back at}}, {{l|en|retaliate}}, {{l|en|take revenge}}
* {{sense|treat revengefully}} {{l|en|spite}}
* See also [[Thesaurus:avenge]]
